title: OS Window Chrome Layout Fix
description: Migrate the raw-wgpu OS/playground stack from browser-only wasm-bindgen/web-sys to winit windowing/input (native + web) and trunk build tooling, plus native hot-swappable plugin hosting.
summary: Fixed print window chrome to use one continuous U-shaped outline: header caps render outside the body tcolorbox so side borders are not duplicated, body carries only L+R+B with hairline overlap, gap stroke uses the same colframe token as tab caps, and borderless boxed style covers headerless Semiobox.
